value.rationale: Exact spherical normal-cone masses encode which vertex is exposed by a random linear functional, a central intrinsic characteristic of a polytope. A complete three-level angular spectrum and all multiplicities across every matching deletion is a natural global classification even though the proof uses elementary extreme-rank symmetry. It distinguishes vertex categories that the scalar width invariant cannot distinguish and gives strict relative weights for a canonical family.
